const ctx = $('Explode tx').item.json;
const tx = ctx._tx;
const raw = $json.content?.[0]?.text || '{}';
let a = {};
try { const m = raw.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); a = JSON.parse(m ? m[0] : raw); } catch { a = { confidence: 0, reasoning: 'parse error' }; }
return [{ json: {
  user_id: ctx.user_id,
  bridge_transaction_id: tx.id,
  bridge_account_id: tx.account_id,
  date: tx.date,
  description: tx.description || tx.clean_description || '',
  raw_description: tx.description || '',
  amount: tx.amount,
  type: tx.amount > 0 ? 'credit' : 'debit',
  category: a.category || null,
  subcategory: a.subcategory || null,
  pcg_account: a.pcg_account || null,
  pcg_label: a.pcg_label || null,
  ai_confidence: a.confidence || 0,
  ai_reasoning: a.reasoning || '',
  tva_rate: a.tva_rate ?? null,
  tva_amount: a.tva_amount ?? null,
  ht_amount: a.ht_amount ?? null,
  tva_deductible: !!a.tva_deductible,
  is_cca: !!a.is_cca,
  is_ik: !!a.is_ik,
  is_amortizable: !!a.is_amortizable,
  counterpart_name: a.counterpart_name || tx.merchant_name || null,
  tags: a.tags || [],
  is_anomaly: !!a.is_anomaly,
} }];
